mentions.name: Immortal ASCII cat
mentions.description: An autonomous Tamagotchi-style immortal ASCII cat, implemented as a quine designed to run forever on the Akash network. It holds its own crypto treasury to cover its bills and consults an LLM for support and decisions on what actions to take to stay alive.
mentions.source_excerpt:
trying to map out what an immortal ASCII cat would look like. Basically an autonomous Tamagotchi.

The idea was to create a quine that runs forever on something like Akash network with its own crypto treasury to support and pay it's bills and try to replicate. It would then talk to an LLM for support and actions on what to do to stay alive.
